title: VXAce Looking for RPG Maker VX Ace Card-Based Battle System (Not Full Card Game)

posts.author: GoreBaristas
posts.body:
I’m looking for a
card-style battle system
for
RPG Maker VX Ace
not something like a full card game (deckbuilder is ok) , but more of a traditional RPG battle system that simply
uses cards as a visual or mechanic
(like skills displayed as cards or attacks chosen via cards).
Something similar to the old
Cardgame Skill/Battle System
by Pencilcase27 would be perfect, but I’m open to
anything that uses cards in combat
without turning the whole system into a card game.
If you know of any scripts, engines, or even old forum posts or blog links that might help, I’d really appreciate it
Thanks in advance
